description: Issue #90: #201's worktree was never created, so `commandmate ls` resolves no id for its branch and `git worktree list` does not know it either. The blocking pre-flight refuses the run before anything is created: status failure / stop_reason drift, a per-issue `worktree_unresolved` blocking reason (never the generic `worker_failed`, which would send the operator to read a worker log that does not exist), no worker sent, no out directory, exit 1. completion_check.passed is false — a run that dispatched nobody must not self-report a passed check. Because `--out` was not consumed, the SAME command re-run once the worktree exists goes all the way to success.
